# CI-HERO-REFRESH-ASSERTIONS-001 schema2
Geometry scope [registered before edits](https://github.com/anitaguptaoffice/sanguo-slg/issues/2325#issuecomment-6720912965). Authority [#2325](https://github.com/anitaguptaoffice/sanguo-slg/issues/2325), companion runner [#2326](https://github.com/anitaguptaoffice/sanguo-slg/issues/2326). Draft NEVER MERGE. This pure component owns the complete evidence decision, with no browser or input capability.
`validateBefore(snapshot)` checks original checked-gold focus and complete raw boundary schema without modifying snapshots.
`correlateCity(arm, rows, returned, returnedAt)` requires object identity with the first sent city request, full sequential rows, finite timing, successful response and no city request in flight at arm.
`validateRefresh(phase, variant, hero)` replays that correlation from saved rows and returned ID; a trusted boolean cannot replace raw protocol, row, descriptor, event or frame evidence.
`validateCompletion(report, {variant,width,provenance})` replays the phase and verifies six clean immutable sources, viewport and completion status. It is necessary but cannot certify runtime A's later database, economy and cleanup checks.
Phase owns cursor/windowStart, before, two raw row points, arm, response, requestRows, settled, three frames, events and eventsEnd. All clocks are finite and ordered; equal wall milliseconds are allowed.
Raw row points use a separate WeakMap registry, retained original/replacement/roster IDs, tag, hero attribute, connection, parent and ancestor IDs. They prove actual same-hero render replacement, not unique RPC causality.
Baseline must show detached old gold, new checked gold, BODY outside and zero or one fully validated original-gold focusout; DOM removal need not dispatch focusout. Fixed must preserve original gold identity/focus with no events. Both require full descriptor/group/projection schemas.
No keydown, input, change, unknown event, overflow, copied active substitution, skipped sample or later-response fallback is accepted.
The executable suite prints exact counter totals across schema, descriptors, group, event, timing, protocol, identity and completion negatives. It exports only synthetic fixtures for the native wrapper tests.
Run `node live_hero_refresh_assertions.test.mjs`; the exact unchanged C283160ae geometry module is required; no browser is used. Exact source/component and composed reviews plus actual mapping remain publication/use gates; pure tests are not native acceptance.
Each observed frame now includes raw C gold/roster measurements between its original observer snapshot and geometryAfter. Geometry validation owns raw geometry; shared focusFrame checks both snapshots for variant focus/held/root/disclosure semantics. Boundary schemas, identities, rectangles, finite clocks, ancestor IDs/names, scroll extents and nine raw hit samples must agree; fixed samples and screenshot brackets require full gold visibility and a real sampled hit.
Fixed viewport continuity permits at most C's existing one-pixel rounding allowance around unchanged/clamped scrollTop. Extent changes may also produce browser anchoring only when gold's owner-relative viewport Y stays within one pixel and additional scroll movement lies in the signed content-extent change interval. Growth below the focus cannot license an arbitrary jump; shrink clamps remain explicit. This registered finite tolerance requires final source/composition/mapping review; old schema1 DOM evidence earns no geometry credit.
Baseline still proves the original focus/identity defect and archives complete geometry without claiming viewport success. Fixed checks cover pre-arm, three rAF-separated multi-roundtrip brackets and both screenshot brackets, not every instant or all resource/layout combinations. Top-level schema2 rejects old schema1; observer snapshots remain schema1. All original401 negatives remain, plus malformed geometry, occlusion/clipping, extent/identity/time, viewport and raster-completion controls.
